title: Acceptance for a linear target
statement: Let $n,r\in\mathbb{N}$, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $s:\{0,1\}^r\to\mathbb{F}_2^n$ be a seed map. If the binary encoding $F:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{F}_2$ of $f$ satisfies $F(x+y)=F(x)+F(y)$ for all $x,y\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, then the derandomized BLR program has the deterministic outcome true and cost $(0,3,n+r+(2n+1)+3)$ with probability one.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean target function on the sign cube
Seed map from $r$ bits to the $n$-dimensional binary cube
The binary encoding of the target is additive on every pair of inputs
